text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By answering the cheers of the people from 
the Kokura shopping district and 
delivering results, Nice Nature managed to 
gain just a little bit of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With newfound confidence in her heart, 
Nice Nature wishes to enter the Kikuka Sho 
to challenge Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Right before leaving Kokura, 
Nice Nature receives a handmade origami 
trophy from her Trainer as proof of her 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heartened by such thoughtfulness, Nice 
Nature declares that she'll give it her 
all in the next race as well.
